changes.tariffModel: Direct Magis pay-per-use price is connector/station price exposed in the Magis E-mobility app at use time; no current public deterministic network-wide AC/DC pay-per-use amount proven.
changes.directVsRoaming: First-party terms explicitly separate Magis-owned/public charging from roaming on other CPO infrastructure, where the app shows a transaction-specific roaming amount.
positiveEvidence: Current Magis Smart subscription page confirms pay-per-use exists and says its cost is calculated from tariffs shown in the app at time of use.

Current first-party subscription tariffs: AC Small 0.60 EUR/kWh + 5 EUR/month; AC Medium 0.58 + 10 EUR/month; AC Large 0.50 + 20 EUR/month; DC Flat 0.74 + 10 EUR/month. These are eligibility/subscription prices, not default direct pay-per-use prices.
Current app terms state Fast Flat discount applies only to Magis-owned stations and separately define roaming pricing on other CPO infrastructure.
negativePaths: Do not infer default pay-per-use tariff from discounted subscription prices.
Do not use roaming prices displayed by Magis app as direct IT*ASS CPO tariff.
Historical 2023/2024 tariffs or subscription kWh bundles are not promoted as current pay-per-use.
changes.blockingCondition: Deterministic IT*ASS EVSE/connector -> Magis app/backend/QR direct pay-per-use tariff mapping, or a current first-party publication proving a universal direct pay-per-use grid.
